exposure: domestic violence (lifetime, during pregnancy, and in the past year)
cohort: The study included 113 postpartum women who delivered via emergency caesarean section or operative vaginal delivery in two tertiary hospitals in Athens, Greece.
finding: Multivariate analysis identified traumatic childbirth, state anxiety, and domestic violence during pregnancy as significant predictors of postpartum post-traumatic stress.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section and operative vaginal delivery defined the high-risk cohort, and women with traumatic childbirth experiences had a 14.7-fold higher risk of developing P-PTSD.
